variation: Standing bilateral supinated dumbbell curl, strict torso, both arms together
camera: Fixed almost-front three-quarter view, athlete turned 15 degrees towards image left; both hands and dumbbells fully visible. Portrait 1024x1536, whole head and shoes in frame, camera near lower chest height, no perspective/scale changes.
anchors: Both shoe soles, heels, toes, pelvis, head and shoulders remain fixed. Upper arms remain beside ribs. Only elbow flexion and attached forearms/hands/dumbbells move.
equipment: Two identical modest round-ended dark-grey dumbbells; same handle length and head diameter in all six. No numerical weight labels. Each hand fully wraps its handle, palms forward/up throughout.
primary: Biceps brachii on both arms, deep purple
secondary: Visible brachialis and brachioradialis only, lighter lilac
stabilisers: Subtle pale purple at forearm grip muscles and trunk only; leave chest, deltoids and legs white-grey.

states.body: start: both elbows approximately 5 degrees flexion from straight. Shoulders, upper arms, head, torso, pelvis, knees and feet hold the master position. Neutral wrists and supinated grip.
states.equipment: Dumbbells follow forearm arcs around fixed elbows; rigid handles stay centred in the palms. Both bells move synchronously, neither changes dimensions.
states.cableAndStack: Not applicable; no machine, cable or stack.
